fusions.name: Rehearsed Lunge
fusions.desc: Claws an enemy up to 4 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Flawless Pounce
fusions.desc: Pounces onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away for 32 damage that is always a critical hit, and strips 20% of its armour for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Muscle Memory
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one random ability, darts you 2 tiles forward, and increases your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Studied Feints
fusions.desc: Every blow you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 7% more damage per stack (33% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
